body: Rapper 42Dugg is making a serious statement about his sneaker collection. The Detroit rapper says his collection is the best in the city and claims it’s valued at more than $1 million — with the collection reportedly built around rare, exclusive, and highly sought-after pairs. For Dugg, the sneakers aren’t just footwear — they’re a major part of his style, culture, and personal collection.
